Two marked sessions and a control completed the stills Custom Mode cycle: Assign with the markers present, change the 13 unnamed cells, confirm Recall, leave the menu until an M save posted, then read the cells in a new session. All three runs agree. The next session restored the live change (`49920 + index` in the unnamed cells, `3200` in the named cells). Recall did not put back the values from Assign time. A direct call of the mapped setter changed only index 5, 12, or 13. A direct call of the whole-key default set all 16 cells to 0. That function's menu caller does not pass UI ids 2017, 2031, or 2034.

The 12-byte AF profile (zone type, size, and position for three orientations, plus the current custom size) fits in the 26 unnamed bytes with a magic, version, length, and CRC. All-zero and the stock value `0x0C80` both fail the magic, so a reset to ROM zeros decodes as no profile. The old six-dword layout is withdrawn.

The key stays unresolved because two generic writers can still carry a key taken from a record or a parameter, and neither is proved unable to name `0x5b82`.
